nhse13.title: The long drive home
nhse13.caption: Six hours in one car can test anyone. Snacks for both moods, taking turns on the sound, and one good question in traffic turn a long drive into time together. Save this for the trip home.

nhse14.title: Two families, one day
nhse14.caption: Two invitations for the same day can feel like a tug of war. Make the plan as a team first, leave room to breathe between visits, and take turns year to year.

nhse15.title: The gift that missed
nhse15.caption: Opening a gift you don't love can freeze your smile. Thank the thought first, find the part you do like, and if honesty is needed, save it for later and keep it kind.

nhse16.title: The quiet one
nhse16.caption: Some friends go quiet in December because the month is heavy for them. A no-pressure text and one specific plan can mean more than you know. Who could you check on today?

nhse17.title: Their family's tradition
nhse17.caption: Walking into someone else's family traditions can feel strange at first. Stay curious, ask how it started, and join in at a level that feels like you. There's usually a sweet story inside.

nhse18.title: Working the holiday
nhse18.caption: When one of you works the holiday, the day itself can feel lonely. Pick your own date, keep one small ritual, and save a plate instead of a guilt trip.

nhse19.title: The gift you didn't see coming
nhse19.caption: Getting a gift when you have nothing to give back can set off a quiet panic. A real thank you is enough. If you want to give later, let it come from the heart, not the pressure.

nhse20.title: When the day goes sideways
nhse20.caption: When the big day goes sideways, it's easy to feel like you ruined it. Laugh first, lower the bar to simply being together, and name one thing that went right.

nhse21.title: The day-after slump
nhse21.caption: The quiet after the holidays can hit harder than you expect. Give yourself one slow day, get outside for a few minutes, and put one small, nice plan on the calendar.

nhse22.title: The New Year's plan
nhse22.caption: Wanting a big night when your person wants pajamas isn't a problem to win. Say what you really want, find the overlap, and build a plan you both actually like.

nhse23.title: The year-end check-in
nhse23.caption: Before the year ends, try three questions together: your favourite moment, what was hard, and what you want more of. Listen to the hard one gently. Save this for a cozy night in.

nhse24.title: You made it
nhse24.caption: If the holidays left you tired, you're not doing it wrong. You held boundaries, asked for help, and were gentle with yourself. Rest is allowed, and you made it.
